items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: The bass player gave me that name. T.G. Rouchon. Bass player... So T.G. Rouchon said well my name would be the best... So that's why they named the band after me.

ctx.x: Thomas Valentine. You have any middle name? No middle name. When did they start calling you the kid? Where did that come in?

When I came down here. Just down? When I came down here. The bass player gave me that name. T.G. Rouchon. Bass player. Oh yeah. See they was going to pick, you know when we organized the band, they was going to see what name would match, you know what I mean, for the band. You know what I mean? So T.G. Rouchon said well my name would be the best. See? So that's why they named the band after me. After me. So then after that well, see another boy he was manager of the band, Fais. Because he had the band before I…

See? We might start in just a little bit at the beginning. Give the very first facts about your life. The date that you were born. I think we have that, but just to be sure we have it all down. Uh huh. Yeah. Where were you born?
